title: American Greed
description:
S11 E19 — Lesson in Greed; Soldier Scam
A school supply vendor steals millions from Detroit public schools by enlisting shady school officials; crooks use photos of real military men to lure women into sending them love and money.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E3 — Fool's Gold
Philanthropist, diplomat, international man of mystery, and criminal Dr Henry Jones led a double-life that was unknown to all he knew.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E6 — $1.2 Billion Scam: Ft. Frauderdale
Scott Rothstein, a Ft. Lauderdale attorney making millions, is the life of the party and a guy who wants the world to love him, while also secretly playing the part of criminal mastermind.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E15 — All-Star Sports Scam
Well-heeled financial advisor Peggy Ann Fulford builds a cache of all-star clients and a personal fortune by convincing A-list players like Dennis Rodman that she's in their corner.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E16 — Judgment of Terror
When a judge in Texas is shot four times, a tip leads investigators to Chimene Onyeri, an aspiring Houston rap artist facing prison after his crooked card skimming plots are exposed.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E7 — The Polygamist and the Bio Fuel Baron
CEO Jacob Kingston appears to be a rising star in Utah's fledgling biofuel industry, until a member of a secretive polygamist group called The Order reveals that Kingston is committing a 1.1 billion dollar fraud.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E9 — COVID Cons
While an estimated $100 billion in COVID relief funds is stolen, this seasoned family of fraudsters easily grabs millions of dollars Americans desperately need to buy themselves mansions, jewelry and gold.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E3 — A Mother's Costly Revenge
A financial fraudster seeks deadly revenge after being placed behind bars for propositioning his assistant's daughter.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E3 — The Prisoner of Wall Street
A man is convicted of wire fraud and money laundering after claiming to sell coffee futures.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E6 — Union Bu$ter; The Fool's Gold
Construction workers unwittingly foot the bill for Melissa King's lifestyle; a smooth-talking ladies-man creates a phony gold scheme.
